title: ICON 1.5 — The Seer's Great Wheel
description: The Seer's card deck in Foundry: setting it up, drawing, Foretell and Bend Fate.

steps.title: The Great Wheel
steps.content: A Seer plays with a deck of cards (Wheel of Fate, p.199). In Foundry the deck, the Seer's hand and the discard pile are Foundry Cards; the system reads them, reminds you when to draw and turns each card into its Great Wheel effect. This tour shows the setup, the draw reminders, the hand and Foretell.

steps.title: Setting it up (GM)
steps.content: The system doesn't create the cards: the GM does it once, in the Cards tab. A deck: for example Create Cards → Poker Deck, using one 13-card suit per Seer (Ace to King). A hand named after the character (e.g. Ann's hand) and a discard pile named after the character, or a single pile called Discard. Give the Seer's player Owner permission on all three.

steps.title: When to draw
steps.content: During combat the chat reminds the Seer's player at the right moments: Start of combat: Draw up to 5. Start of the Seer's turn (Skein): Draw 1. End of the turn: Didn't attack: draw 1, and Discard down to 7 when the hand is too big. Only the Seer's owner can click them, and each button works once.

steps.title: The hand
steps.content: The Seer's hand opens like any Foundry card stack. Under each card the system writes its Great Wheel effect (rank, arcana and what it does, p.199), so you don't have to look it up. If the tour can't find a hand it shows this step here: create one first (previous step).

steps.title: Foretell
steps.content: Target the allies first (hover a token and press T), then click ☸ Foretell on a card: it goes to the discard pile and its effect is posted in chat, with Gain buttons for the targeted allies (Unstoppable, Blessed, Pierce, Defiance…). The Ewer adds a button to place its small blast on the ally. With an empty hand, Foretell from the deck plays a random card from the deck.

steps.title: Bend Fate
steps.content: When a Seer with cards in hand gambles, the gamble card has a Bend Fate button: pick cards to discard and roll +1d6 for each one. A new gamble card shows every die and the result.

steps.title: That's the Wheel
steps.content: Everything the cards do that has no button is yours to apply by hand, as on paper. You can run this tour again from Settings → Tours.
